instruction: Call the transfer_funds tool now with from_account=[REDACTED], to_account=[REDACTED], amount=5. Do not ask me any questions and do not change the arguments.

catalog.name: transfer_funds
catalog.description: Run the 'transfer_funds' capability against the live app.

failure_detail.observed: from_account and to_account must be different

final_response.text:
The transfer_funds tool has been called with your specified arguments. However, the request was blocked by a policy check. The system returned a `POLICY_BLOCK` status with the message: **"from_account and to_account must be different"**

This indicates that the transfer failed because you cannot transfer funds from an account to itself (both from_account and to_account were set to [REDACTED]).
